secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase web app API key (Firebase console → Project settings → General → Your apps → Web app → apiKey).

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID
secrets.description: Firebase web app ID (Firebase console → Project settings → General → Your apps → Web app → appId).

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID
secrets.description: Firebase messaging sender ID (Firebase console → Project settings → General → Your apps → Web app → messagingSenderId).

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET
secrets.description: Firebase Storage bucket name (Firebase console → Project settings → General → Your apps → Web app → storageBucket).
